hero.title: Scalable
hero.description: I'm Alex Roblero, a Systems Engineering student and self-taught full-stack developer. I don't sell promises: I build real software and leave it open for you to verify — production-deployed applications, 35 passing E2E tests, and professional workflow with Azure DevOps, Scrum, and PR reviews. Every project is evidence that I learn by building.
